messages.subject: Error in MethylKit
parts:
When I ran my program earlier today it ran all the way through with no problems, however, when I run the exact same code now I keep getting an error at the first line after I read in my files:

filtered.methRaw_CpG <- filterByCoverage(methRaw_CpG, lo.count = 10, lo.perc = NULL, hi.count = NULL, hi.perc = 99.9)

This line has worked many times before but now it has error:

Error in quantile.default(data$coverage, hi.perc/100) : 
    missing values and NaN's not allowed if 'na.rm' is FALSE
 Calls: filterByCoverage ... lapply -> FUN -> FUN -> quantile -> quantile.default

any assistance in figuring out what could be causing this would be greatly appreciated
